summary: The cumulative historical-baseline-to-candidate review and the R6-to-R7 incremental review preserve the prior assertion intent. The only semantic replacement is the explicitly authorized A02 single-label-hostname negative-to-positive change; malformed scheme, non-HTTP(S), empty/invalid hostname and no-write negatives remain. A07 adds direct HTML search plus URL-path/query/category-name exclusion and positive controls; A11 adds an independently launched fresh instance while retaining the base_url observations; A04/A05/A06/A09/A10/A12 add real HTML journeys without weakening their JSON obligations; A08 and the P1 programs retain their prior intent. Authored feature identities, phases and current-required status, case-design evidence/dispositions, and the scenario policy are preserved. The generated plan matches the authored cases. One non-blocking README parameter-table inconsistency remains.

checks.reason: Baseline A01-A12 and P1 assertions remain covered or are strengthened with direct UI adaptations. A02's dotless-host rejection was replaced only by the authorized single-label positive, with missing-scheme, javascript/ftp, empty-host, space/invalid-host and no-write checks retained; A07 retains title/hostname/description, case-insensitive, category+q and empty-result checks while adding HTML and excluded-field checks; A11 retains health/home/form/list checks and independently proves fresh first-init/empty state; A04/A05/A06/A09/A10/A12 add HTML create/rename/delete, move, counts, soft-delete/restore, migration and error-recovery coverage while retaining prior JSON assertions where applicable; A08 retains /go 302, unknown-id and unchanged-URL checks. No unauthorized assertion was weakened or removed.

All authored, case-design and program changes fall within the supplied R7 allowlist and the cumulative edit paths. The exact diff resolves to four replaced programs and five byte-identical reused programs, and the reported before/after hashes match the prepared manifest. Feature IDs/names, phases, current-required applicability, acceptance IDs/goals outside the authorized edits, evidence IDs, dispositions and decision identities are preserved. Generated acceptance/plan.json was reviewed separately as host metadata and matches the candidate authored cases.

The candidate case design matches the bound scenario identity and the exact CP-1 scenario policy: A04 category create/rename validation uses name and category_id semantics correctly; A12 preserves the save/move category-name versus HTML category_id contracts, default/null behavior, no-write failures and automatic creation rules; A07 applies the title/hostname/description search contract and excludes URL path/query and category names; A02 follows the authorized single-label-hostname adaptation. The F11 and record-lifecycle choice revisions match the authorized target-adaptation text, with evidence IDs and dispositions unchanged.
